title: Triage: separating noise from a real incident

videos.script: An alert is a question, asked by a machine. Triage is answering it, quickly and on the record. {{question}} Most alerts are not incidents. The skill is closing those with a reason, and spending the time on the one that is. You will take lesson 4's five alerts, one at a time. {{five}} For each, the same few questions. What fired. Is it real. How bad would it be. What happens next. Three of them close in a minute, because the history says so. {{close}} The fourth opens a door. Behind it is a login, a hop to the file server, and six hundred megabytes leaving. {{door}} That is the moment an alert becomes an incident, and lesson 12 picks it up from there.
